# standardurgy

> LGD-aligned term-registration asset. Four-angle score: LGD 82/100.
> Methodology for creating standards: strength tiers (L0-L4) + three laws (Registered/Verified/Gated).

## What this is

`standardurgy` is a **term-registration** claim in the LGD naming system (meta-layer-creation family). It registers the term *standardurgy* — the methodology for creating credible standards via strength-tiered judgment rather than committee voting.
